title: Tuesday Daily Practice
subtitle: Listening Section 1: Greenfield Language Club form and error log
theme: Trial Lesson 2 · Busy lives and how things are made
source: DailyPractice_Trial2_Student.pdf / DailyPractice_Trial2_Teacher.pdf (Pre-IELTS Trial Lesson 2, Daily Practice), Tuesday 3/11 (Listening Section 1, self-written transcript)
intro: Work through 4 steps, about 50 minutes. Listen in step 2 at most twice; do not read the answers first. Deadline 23:30 the same day: complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow. Boost (optional): listen to BBC 6 Minute English and write down 5 numbers or dates you hear.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good morning, Greenfield Language Club. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hello. I’d like some information about your evening courses, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Of course. Can I take your name first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. My first name is Nadia.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And your surname?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It’s Hartley. That’s H-A-R-T-L-E-Y.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you. And a mobile number, in case we need to call you?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it’s zero seven four one two, eight five nine, six three zero.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let me check: zero seven four one two, eight five nine, six three zero. Perfect.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great. I was thinking about the Grammar Basics course, but I really need to improve for an exam.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then I’d choose our IELTS preparation course. It’s very popular.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, that sounds better. I’ll take the IELTS preparation course.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. The next group starts on the fifth of November.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, that’s a bit early for me. Is there a later group?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, there’s another one starting on the twelfth of November.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The twelfth is fine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The classes are on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, from half past six.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Six thirty. Good. How much is it?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It was forty pounds a month last year, but now it’s forty-five.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Forty-five. OK. Is there anything extra?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: There’s a one-time registration fee of fifteen pounds.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fifteen. Right. And where are the classes?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In Room twelve, on the second floor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Twelve, second floor. What should I bring on the first day?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Please bring a photo ID, like a passport. We also need a student card if you have one, but that’s optional.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A photo ID. Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You’re welcome. We’ll see you on the twelfth.

steps.title: Step 1 · Predict the answer type
steps.instructions: Read the form before listening. For each gap, guess the answer type and type one word from the list: name · spelling · number · date · price · time · place · thing.

items.label: 2. Surname: ______
items.explain: Họ thường được đánh vần từng chữ cái, nên phải nghe spelling.

steps.title: Step 2 · Listening Section 1
steps.instructions: Listen once, then listen once more. Do not read the answers first. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each gap. Greenfield Language Club · Membership enquiry. (Self-written practice, not a real exam.)

items.label: 4. Course chosen: ______
items.explain: Bẫy: Grammar Basics được nhắc trước nhưng chị Nadia đổi sang IELTS preparation.

items.label: 5. Start date: ______ November
items.explain: Bẫy: ngày 5 được nói trước, sau đó đổi sang ngày 12.

items.label: 6. Classes Tuesday and Thursday, starting at ______ pm
7. Monthly fee: £ ______
items.explain: Bẫy: forty pounds là giá năm ngoái.

items.label: 8. Registration fee (one time): £ ______
items.explain: fifteen (nhấn âm cuối) khác fifty (nhấn âm đầu).

items.label: 9. Classroom: Room ______
items.explain: second floor là tầng, không phải số phòng.

items.label: 10. Bring on the first day: ______
items.explain: Bẫy: student card chỉ là tùy chọn.

steps.title: Step 3 · Error log
steps.instructions: For each wrong answer in step 2, write the question number and the reason: spelling · number · changed information (distractor) · plural · other. Finally write one sentence: 'Next time I will ...'.

open.model: Q5: changed information (distractor). I wrote 5, but the speaker changed it to the twelfth. Next time I will wait until the speaker confirms the final answer.

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note: names and numbers
steps.instructions: Record about 20 seconds: spell your first and last name letter by letter in English, read your phone number slowly in groups, and say today's date.
lines: 1. My first name is ... That's ... (spell it).
3. My phone number is ... (say it slowly, in groups).
4. Today is Tuesday, the third of November.
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét cách đọc chữ cái và con số.

send_today: Hoàn thành 4 bước trên web. Voice note ở bước 4 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
